Want to suggest a guest?
Samay Raina sits down for one of his most honest conversations yet.
We go beyond the viral moments, into the real story behind India’s Got Latent, what the controversy actually cost him (financially and mentally), his relationship with his father, the Kashmiri Exodus, and why he turned to Osho’s Ashtavakra Gita in the middle of it all.
This isn’t just an interview. It’s a genuine conversation about fame, identity, art, and what it means to keep going when everything blows up around you.
